Game Overview

Survival UFO is a adventure title where survive in a vast alien world, navigating treacherous terrains and battling diverse creatures. Gather resources to craft powerful tools and shelters, strategically balancing exploration and safety. With evolving challenges and a persistent environment, how long can you endure the alien nights? Your wits and persistence are your greatest weapons.
